summary: Implemented the print_json feature in the rich repository, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/highlighter.py adds JSONHighlighter (base style "json.", one combined pattern for brace, literals, number, str); rich/default_styles.py adds the six json.* theme entries; rich/json.py (new) adds the JSON renderable, which stores the highlighted Text in `text`, plus a __main__ CLI with soft_wrap and an "Unable to read" error path; rich/console.py adds Console.print_json after print with a lazy import; rich/__init__.py adds package-level print_json between print and inspect, leaving __all__ unchanged. Tests: test_print_json in tests/test_console.py checks the exact truecolor ANSI output, and test_rich_print_json in tests/test_rich_print.py checks the plain output. Docs: a "Printing JSON" section in docs/source/console.rst, a new docs/source/reference/json.rst, a toctree entry in docs/source/reference.rst, and a CHANGELOG.md entry under Unreleased. Expected test values were derived by reading the code and have not been executed; the user should run the test suite to confirm.
